title: Units per Month on a PAP Supply Replenishment Program Standing-Order Line
content:
**Rule.** For a standing-order cushion line of the Self-Pay Supply Subscription in the PAP Supply Replenishment Program, the units per month are worked out as follows:

1. when the cushion item of the recorded style differs from the item of the latest standing-order cushion line, they are the units of the recorded style's item the patient collected at a branch in the last 3 calendar months divided by three, rounded up to a whole unit;
2. when the item is the same and the patient also collected units of it at a branch in the last 3 calendar months, they are the latest standing-order line's units per month plus the result of dividing those branch units by three and rounding it up to a whole unit.

Where the item is the same and nothing of it was collected at a branch in the last 3 calendar months, no branch-based change applies.

## Terms

- **Latest standing-order cushion line:** the newest self-pay cushion line on the enrollment that went out by ground; its units per month are its units divided by the months it covered (whole calendar months from ship date to covered-through date, plus one).
- **Units collected at a branch in the last 3 calendar months:** the units on self-pay lines of the recorded style's cushion item picked up at a Summit Ridge branch, with a ship date fewer than 3 whole calendar months before the handling day.

## Input — judgement — output (hypothetical figures)

| Recorded style's item vs. latest standing-order item | Branch units of the recorded item, last 3 months | Latest line's units per month | Units per month |
|---|---|---|---|
| different | 5 | (not used) | 5 divided by 3 is about 1.67, rounded up: 2 |
| different | 0 | (not used) | 0 |
| same | 4 | 2 | 2 plus (4 divided by 3 is about 1.33, rounded up: 2), which is 4 |
| same | 0 | 2 | no branch-based change |

The rounding up applies to the branch units divided by three; the latest line's units per month is not rounded.
